From b8f8dbf6495850b0babc551377bde754b7bc0eea Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thomas Zimmermann <tzimmermann@suse.de>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2020 16:25:36 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/vram-helper: Fix use of top-down placement
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Commit 7053e0eab473 ("drm/vram-helper: stop using TTM placement flags")
cleared the BO placement flags if top-down placement had been selected.
Hence, BOs that were supposed to go into VRAM are now placed in a default
location in system memory.

Trying to scanout the incorrectly pinned BO results in displayed garbage
and an error message.

[  146.108127] 
diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c
index 50cad0e4a92e..375c79e23ca5 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c
@@ -140,7 +140,7 @@ static void drm_gem_vram_placement(struct drm_gem_vram_object *gbo,
 	unsigned int c = 0;
 
 	if (pl_flag & DRM_GEM_VRAM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN)
-		pl_flag = TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN;
+		invariant_flags = TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN;
 
 	gbo->placement.placement = gbo->placements;
 	gbo->placement.busy_placement = gbo->placements;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c`**
   - The line that previously set `pl_flag` to `TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN` when the top-down placement flag was active has been changed. 
   - Instead of modifying `pl_flag`, the patch now assigns `TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN` to `invariant_flags`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `drm_gem_vram_helper.c` addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (7053e0eab473) that incorrectly cleared the buffer object (BO) placement flags when top-down placement was selected. By changing the assignment from `pl_flag` to `invariant_flags`, the patch ensures that BOs intended for VRAM are correctly placed, preventing them from defaulting to system memory and avoiding issues such as displayed garbage and error messages during scanout. This change restores the intended behavior of the top-down placement functionality.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the clearing of the buffer object (BO) placement flags when top-down placement was selected, which led to BOs being placed in a default location in system memory instead of the intended VRAM. This resulted in incorrect memory placement and subsequent display issues when trying to scanout the incorrectly pinned BO.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void drm_gem_vram_placement(struct drm_gem_vram_object *gbo,
 				   unsigned long pl_flag)
 {
 	u32 invariant_flags = 0;
 	unsigned int i;
 	unsigned int c = 0;
 
 	if (pl_flag & DRM_GEM_VRAM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN)
-		pl_flag = TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN;
+		invariant_flags = TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN;
 
 	gbo->placement.placement = gbo->placements;
 	gbo->placement.busy_placement = gbo->placements;
 
 	if (pl_flag & DRM_GEM_VRAM_PL_FLAG_VRAM) {
 		gbo->placements[c].mem_type = TTM_PL_VRAM;
 		gbo->placements[c++].flags = TTM_PL_FLAG_WC |
 					     TTM_PL_FLAG_UNCACHED |
 					     invariant_flags;
 	}
 
 	if (pl_flag & DRM_GEM_VRAM_PL_FLAG_SYSTEM || !c) {
 		gbo->placements[c].mem_type = TTM_PL_SYSTEM;
 		gbo->placements[c++].flags = TTM_PL_MASK_CACHING |
 					     invariant_flags;
 	}
 
 	gbo->placement.num_placement = c;
 	gbo->placement.num_busy_placement = c;
 
 	for (i = 0; i < c; ++i) {
 		gbo->placements[i].fpfn = 0;
 		gbo->placements[i].lpfn = 0;
 	}
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (pl_flag & DRM_GEM_VRAM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN)
    pl_flag = TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN;
```
Reason:
When the top-down placement flag is selected, the code erroneously clears the buffer object (BO) placement flags by assigning `TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN` to `pl_flag`. As a result, the intended VRAM placement is ignored, causing BOs to default to being placed in system memory instead of VRAM, leading to display issues.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (pl_flag & DRM_GEM_VRAM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN)
    invariant_flags = TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN;
```
Reason:
This change retains the top-down placement flag in a separate variable (`invariant_flags`) instead of overwriting the `pl_flag`. Consequently, the BO placement flags are preserved, allowing the BOs to be correctly placed in VRAM as intended, resolving the display issues.
